hooks.command: f="$(python -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or '')" 2>/dev/null)"; case "$f" in backend/*.py) "backend/.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe" format "$f"; "backend/.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe" check "$f" ;; frontend/src/*.ts|frontend/src/*.tsx|frontend/src/*.js|frontend/src/*.jsx|frontend/src/*.css|frontend/src/*.json) rel="${f#frontend/}"; (cd frontend && npx --no-install prettier --write "$rel") ;; esac
